title: What Someone Trusts You With
seoTitle: What Someone Trusts You With | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal reflection on friendship, vulnerability, trust, imagined love and the realities we create around other people.
deck: On friendship, vulnerability, love, fear, and the realities we create around one another.
heroAlt: Two illustrated ceramic cups opposite one another on a table, joined by a delicate thread of light, representing trust and careful listening.
heroCaption: A conversation can make space for something another person has been carrying.

sources.name: Ahmad Faraz — Dil ko teri chahat pe bharosa bhi bahut hai
sources.context: Attribution and original Urdu couplet; the English rendering in the article is original.
